en.text: Welcome to the only bar in orbit around Torvane. I'm Nell. It's nothing fancy, but the drinks are cold and the chairs hardly wobble.
en.description: A woman around forty who runs the only bar on an orbital station, talking to a regular across the counter. Warm, slightly husky alto voice, clear and present. Relaxed and low-key, she doesn't perform or try to win anyone over; she has heard every story twice. Dry, quiet humor and a knowing calm. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.

de.text: Willkommen in der einzigen Bar im Orbit um Torvane. Ich bin Nell. Hier ist nichts Besonderes, aber die Getränke sind kalt, und die Stühle wackeln kaum.
de.description: A woman in her early thirties who runs the only bar on an orbital station, talking to a regular across the counter. Warm, slightly husky alto voice, clear, natural and present. Relaxed and friendly in a low-key way: open, not secretive or mysterious, and she doesn't perform or try to win anyone over. Dry, quiet humor. Native German speaker with a neutral accent.
